sections.Aims and Fit of Module: The "Industry Innovation" module is designed to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of how innovation drives industry transformation, shapes market leadership, and fosters startup ecosystems. This module equips students with the tools and frameworks to strategically assess, develop, and implement innovation in various business contexts, emphasizing interdisciplinary approaches and real-world applications. By articulating the mechanisms of innovation at different stages of the industry lifecycle, students will be prepared to drive meaningful change in both established enterprises and new ventures. This module aligns with the broader MSc Entrepreneurship and Innovation programme by providing in-depth exposure to cutting-edge innovation strategies, sustainability considerations, and future industry trends. It aims to develop students' ability to critically assess innovation's role in creating competitive advantages and shaping industrial ecosystems, ensuring they are well-prepared to lead transformative projects in their future careers.
sections.Learning outcomes: A Demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of key concepts and technologies in industrial innovation B Analyze how innovation reshapes industry dynamics and identifies growth opportunities C Evaluate ethical, societal, and environmental implications of industrial innovation D Develop actionable strategies to drive innovation within organizations E Create and present an industry-focused business model, considering market needs, technological feasibility, and scalability in both startup and established business contexts
sections.Method of teaching and learning: The module will adopt an industry-driven project-based learning (PBL) approach, prioritizing active, student-centered engagement through real-world projects provided in collaboration with industry partners. This approach will empower students to apply theoretical concepts to tangible challenges, deepening their understanding and fostering the development of critical problem-solving, teamwork, and communication skills. In addition to practical seminars and workshops, students will engage in dynamic, industry-focused discussions on industrial innovation, covering key topics such as entrepreneurial development, sustainability, ethics, and emerging technological trends. These sessions will involve input from guest speakers and industry professionals, offering valuable insights into the latest market developments and best practices. Group sessions will enable students to present their project progress, receive constructive feedback from peers, instructors, and industry mentors, and refine their ideas in real-time. This collaborative environment will ensure that students are well-equipped to address industry challenges and drive innovation in their respective fields.
